title: 第6章 善后警钟第7章 祸水东引危机
content_zh:
夜风拂过山道，带着淡淡的血腥气。
徐长生站在姜老大的尸体旁，剧烈地喘息着。
方才那一剑，几乎榨干了他体内所有的灵气，若非嘴里提前含了一颗极品聚气丹，此刻他恐怕连站都站不稳。
他低头看着姜老大那张扭曲的脸，心中涌起一股复杂的情绪。
这是他第一次杀人。
虽然早有心理准备，虽然知道这是你死我活的争斗，但真正动手的那一刻，他的手还是抖了一下。
“修仙界，果然如父亲所说，弱肉强食，步步杀机。”
徐长生喃喃自语，深吸一口气，压下心头的波澜。
他没有时间感慨。
这里虽然偏僻，但难保不会有人经过。必须尽快处理掉尸体，抹去所有痕迹。
徐长生蹲下身，在姜老大身上摸索起来。
一个鼓囊囊的百宝袋被他扯了下来，入手沉甸甸的，显然里面的东西不少。
除此之外，姜老大腰间还别着一柄短剑，剑鞘朴实无华，但拔出一看，剑身寒光凛冽，显然是一件品相不错的灵器。
“这是……下品灵器？”
徐长生眼睛一亮。
他如今虽然有了天阶功法《乙木青雷剑》，但却一直没有趁手的兵器。施展“青雷初现”时，只能以指代剑，威力大打折扣。
若是有这柄短剑在手，再施展那一剑，威力至少能提升三成！
徐长生将短剑收好，又在姜老大身上仔细搜了一遍，确定没有遗漏任何东西后，这才将目光投向地上的尸体。
如何处理？
他目光扫过四周，落在不远处的湖面上。

湖水幽深，深不见底。
徐长生心中有了计较。他拖着姜老大的尸体，走到湖边，从附近切了几块石头，塞进姜老大的衣襟里，然后用尽力气，将尸体推入湖中。
“噗通”
水花溅起，涟漪荡开。
片刻后，湖面恢复了平静，仿佛什么都没有发生过。
徐长生站在湖边，盯着湖面看了许久，直到确认尸体不会再浮上来，这才长长地吐出一口浊气。
他抬手抹了一把额头的冷汗，转身快步离去。
…………
回到住处时，已是深夜。
同院的杂役弟子早已睡下，院子里静悄悄的，只有偶尔传来的一两声鼾声。
徐长生轻手轻脚地推开自己的房门，闪身进去，然后将门闩死。
他靠在门上，闭上眼，大口大口地喘着气。
今夜的事，太过凶险。
若非他修为快速突破到了练气三层，若非他提前炼化了一颗极品聚气丹，若非他拼死领悟了“青雷初现”，此刻沉在湖底的，恐怕就是他自己了。
侥幸！
content_en:
The night wind blew through the mountain road, carrying a faint smell of blood.
Xu Changsheng stood next to Boss Jiang's body, breathing heavily.
The sword strike just now drained almost all the spiritual energy from his body. If he hadn't had a top-grade Qi Gathering Pill in his mouth in advance, he might not even be able to stand firmly at this moment.
He looked down at Boss Jiang's distorted face, and a complex emotion surged in his heart.
This was his first murder.
Although he was mentally prepared and knew that this was a life-and-death fight, his hands still shook a little when he actually took action.
"In the world of cultivating immortals, it is indeed as my father said. The weak eat the strong and kill at every step."
Xu Changsheng murmured to himself, took a deep breath, and suppressed the waves in his heart.
He didn't have time to sigh.
Although this place is remote, there is no guarantee that no one will pass by. The body must be disposed of as quickly as possible and all traces must be erased.
Xu Changsheng squatted down and started groping around Boss Jiang.
A bulging treasure bag was torn off by him. It was heavy in his hand, and it was obvious that there was a lot of stuff in it.
In addition, Boss Jiang also had a short sword on his waist. The scabbard was simple and plain, but when he pulled it out, he saw that the sword's blade was cold and gleaming. It was obviously a good-quality spiritual weapon.
"This is...a low-grade spiritual weapon?"
Xu Changsheng's eyes lit up.
Although he now has the heaven-level skill "Yimu Qinglei Sword", he has never had a weapon at his disposal. When using "Blue Thunder's First Appearance", you can only point to the sword, which greatly reduces its power.
If you have this short sword in your hand, the power of that sword can be increased by at least 30%!
Xu Changsheng put away the dagger and searched Boss Jiang carefully again. After making sure that nothing was missing, he turned his attention to the corpse on the ground.
How to deal with it?
He glanced around and landed on the lake not far away.
The lake is deep and bottomless.
Xu Changsheng had some concerns in his mind. He dragged Boss Jiang's body to the lake, cut a few rocks from nearby, stuffed them into Boss Jiang's clothes, and then pushed the body into the lake with all his strength.
"Plop"
The water splashed and rippled.
After a while, the lake surface returned to calm, as if nothing had happened.
Xu Changsheng stood by the lake and stared at the lake for a long time. After confirming that the body would not float again, he let out a long breath.
He raised his hand to wipe the cold sweat from his forehead, turned around and left quickly.
…………
When I returned to my residence, it was already late at night.
The handyman disciples in the same courtyard had already gone to bed, and the courtyard was quiet except for the occasional snoring.
Xu Changsheng gently pushed open his door, stepped in, and bolted the door.
He leaned against the door, closed his eyes, and gasped for air.
What happened tonight was too dangerous.
If he hadn't quickly broken through to the third level of Qi training, if he hadn't refined a top-quality Qi-gathering pill in advance, if he hadn't desperately understood "The First Appearance of Blue Thunder", he would probably be the one sinking to the bottom of the lake at this moment.
lucky!
